description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the `SnapshotStreamingActor` class within the Eclipse Ditto project. It uses Akka testkit, Mockito, and AssertJ to verify the behavior of snapshot streaming with both empty and non-empty MongoDB snapshot collections.

classes.name: SnapshotStreamingActorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing snapshot streaming actor behavior, including empty and non-empty snapshot collections, within the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: initActorSystem
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem and mocks required dependencies before each test.

methods.name: shutdownActorSystem
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: streamEmptySnapshotCollection
methods.description: Test case verifying behavior when the snapshot store is empty; expects an empty result set.

methods.name: streamNonemptySnapshotCollection
methods.description: Test case verifying behavior when the snapshot store contains multiple documents; expects proper deserialization into StreamedSnapshot objects.

methods.name: setSnapshotStore
methods.description: Mocks the MongoReadJournal.getNewestSnapshotsAbove method to provide a specified source of Document objects.

methods.name: createSnapshotStreamingActor
methods.description: Creates an ActorRef instance of SnapshotStreamingActor with test-specific props.
